Go to Settings
Not now

title: Untrustworthy!! Transformed itself to an unwanted Widget, destroyed my placements and hid the app
body:
I've been using this app and was - earlier - quite satisfied.  I've systematically saved reminders.  But today it transformed itself to a widget  - out of the blue, wihout my interferrance.  Thereby taking up a lot of room on the first page and destroying the meticulacate placements of all the following apps.
In my mind it is ME who descides where to place apps to make it easy to find what I want.  Not somebody else imposing themselves on me.
The widget gave me the opportunity to get rid of it - promising, that it wouldn't destroy neither app nor notes.  So I did that.  Only to discover, that it was false promises:
The original app has now disappeared!
It exists somewhere, because I can reach it and open it through the appstore - but I can't find it on the phone.  (iPhone 12 pro).
Please help me solve this problem on how to return the app and my notes to my phone
author: Christie.dk

title: Simple & Powerfull
body:
Really enjoying this application. It works extremely well with apple calendar. Having those two separated also has really improved my overview of my different appointments and tasks since they don’t necessarily shows op in it if I don’t want to.

The interface is simple and easy to understand. And it is really flexible in how and when task should repeat.

It automatically shows a daily agenda with all yours tasks from different folders that there are due.

I don’t think I can live without this anymore 😂

title: No Today View on Widget
body:
Why do Apple think that I would want to show a specific list on my widget, when the most important tasks are the ones needed to complete today.
I can’t show today view on the widget because it isn’t a “list”. I tried working around this issue by creating a smart list that would take all the tasks for today, but a smart list doesn’t qualify as a “list” when you go to choose what list to appear on the widget.
This makes the Reminders widget pretty much useless if you want to see todays things at a glance.
I thought Apple had some creative and smart people working for them. Apparently not.
